question: What causes of entrainment of sugar solutions does the paper list, and what damage to the condenser can the entrainment cause?
expect: air leaks, unstable vacuum, foaming substances; scale formation, fouling, erosion and corrosion of the condenser's pipes and headers (p1, introduction)
rendered:

| Cause of Entrainment | Damage to Condenser |
| Air leaks | Scale formation, fouling, erosion, corrosion of pipes and headers |
| Unstable vacuum | Scale formation, fouling, erosion, corrosion of pipes and headers |
| Presence of foaming substances | Scale formation, fouling, erosion, corrosion of pipes and headers |
